subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree is referenced by Jorlan as the authority who decides the fate of failed Drow, and whose hatred for Ilvara has been building in close quarters with a corrupted superior.
source_quote: I fear that her disease will spread.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara, who was once a high priestess of Lolth, has become seduced by this abomination, this idea that Lolth wishes to be married.
source_quote: Ilvara, who was once a high priestess of Lolth, has become seduced by this abomination, this idea that Lolth wishes to be married.

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: The mushroom artifact from Neverlight Grove was the mechanism of corruption.
source_quote: The mushroom artifact from Neverlight Grove was the mechanism of corruption.

subject: Big Heart Fungus
fact: The Big Heart Fungus was the primary weapon, would need sustained damage, would not die quickly or easily.
source_quote: The Big Heart Fungus was the primary weapon, would need sustained damage, would not die quickly or easily.

subject: Dust of Suleiman
fact: The Dust of Suleiman was positioned on the cavern floor as a zone of lethal environmental hazard.
source_quote: I looked at the cavern floor. At the Dust of Suleiman area.

subject: Glyph of Warding
fact: The Glyph of Warding was inscribed into the stone of the bridge, with trigger: any hostile creature crossing, invisible once finished.
source_quote: Jorlan's side. He moved to the crossing and started inscribing the Glyph of Warding into the stone itself.

subject: Light Crossbow
fact: The light crossbow was borrowed from Grygum, checked for sloppiness by pulling the string, sighting down it, confirming the prior owner was not sloppy.
source_quote: I asked him for it. Simple transaction, no drama — he handed it over and I checked the mechanism the way you check anything borrowed before a fight: pull the string, sight down it, make sure the person who owned it before you wasn't sloppy.

subject: Underdark equivalent of a table
fact: The party spread out the options on the Underdark equivalent of a table when crouched in the dark with a drow informant and a borrowed crossbow.
source_quote: Then the party spread out the options on the table, or whatever the Underdark equivalent of a table is when you're crouched in the dark with a drow informant and a borrowed crossbow.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan remained uninfected through hatred, which is its own kind of immunological theory, and maintained twenty feet of maintained distance.
source_quote: Only she and Jorlan remained uninfected — Asha through devotion, Jorlan through hatred, which is its own kind of immunological theory. Twenty feet of maintained distance.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum had a light crossbow, handed it over without drama, and was confirmed as not sloppy in maintenance.
source_quote: Grygum had a light crossbow. I asked him for it. Simple transaction, no drama — he handed it over and I checked the mechanism... He wasn't. That dwarf is okay.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir teleported directly to Ilvara or grabbed her and moved her somewhere unpleasant, and filed teleportation as a weapon under *useful people*.
source_quote: Zalthir said he could teleport directly to Ilvara — or grab her and move her somewhere unpleasant. I stored that. Teleportation as a weapon. Thorin files that away in the part of his brain labeled *useful people.*

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool attempted to pass for a rock; his eyes drifted left and right with the unhurried curiosity of a creature that has never needed to pretend to be geological before.
source_quote: Glabbagool attempted to pass for a rock. The eyes gave him away. They drifted left. They drifted right. They did this with the unhurried curiosity of a creature that has never needed to pretend to be geological before and doesn't fully understand why it's being asked to start now.

subject: Big Heart Fungus
fact: The Big Heart Fungus detonated a twenty-foot spore-thick poison cloud that hung in the cavern air like it had decided to stay — as if it belonged there, as if it had always belonged there, as if we were the interlopers in its home.
source_quote: The cloud didn't drift. That was the first thing I noticed. Normal smoke drifts. Normal gas disperses. This hung in the cavern air like it had decided to stay — twenty feet of spore-thick poison, sitting in the middle of the battlefield as if it belonged there, as if it had always belonged there, as if we were the interlopers in its home.

subject: Divine Possession Rejection
fact: Asha Vandree disbelieved the divine possession claim not because the illusion was poor, but because she had seen this exact con before — probably multiple times, probably from people more practiced than I am, probably in considerably higher-stakes circumstances.
source_quote: She'd disbelieved me because she had seen this exact con before — probably multiple times, probably from people more practiced than I am, probably in considerably higher-stakes circumstances.

subject: Deluded Mage Acceptance
fact: Asha Vandree saw through the lie, built her own explanation out of the wreckage, found it workable, and decided that a spore-maddened wizard with followers and a gelatinous familiar was, on balance, the best available instrument for killing someone she needed dead.
source_quote: She wasn't wrong.

subject: Teleportation Strike
fact: Zalthir stepped through the dark and arrived before Ilvara had finished deciding what to do, drove the weapon in for sixteen damage, locked the grip, and began dragging her toward the Dust of Suleiman.
source_quote: One moment I was reading the geometry of the space — the elevated platform, the sightlines, the gap between us and her — and the next I was already there, adjacent, inside the radius where a priestess stops being an authority and becomes a target... I drove the weapon in. Sixteen. The grip locked... I started moving her toward it.

subject: Fungal Reformation
fact: Ilvara came apart into the fungal matter beneath her feet — flowed through it like water pouring into a crack, like smoke running back into the dark — and reappeared somewhere else on the cavern floor, leaving Zalthir’s grapple holding nothing.
source_quote: She came apart into the fungal matter beneath her feet — flowed through it like water pouring into a crack, like smoke running back into the dark — and reappeared somewhere else on the cavern floor. The grapple didn't break. It simply stopped having anything to hold.

subject: Glyph Activation
fact: The Glyph of Warding was inscribed into the stone of the bridge, invisible once finished, patient in the way only traps can be patient, because they don't get tired.
source_quote: The trigger: any hostile creature crossing. Invisible once finished. Patient in the way only traps can be patient, because they don't get tired.

subject: Crossbow Inspection
fact: The light crossbow was checked by pulling the string, sighting down it, confirming the prior owner wasn't sloppy — a ritual of trust before combat.
source_quote: I checked the mechanism the way you check anything borrowed before a fight: pull the string, sight down it, make sure the person who owned it before you wasn't sloppy.

subject: Scream of Self-Anger
fact: Ilvara screamed not at Zalthir, but at herself — the sound of an illusion breaking, of something she thought couldn't be threatened being hurt.
source_quote: She screamed. Not at me. The GM's exact words: *at herself.* And I caught that — I filed it, the way you file things that tell you something true. She was furious at herself.

subject: Cavern Floor
fact: The cavern floor became a battleground where fungal matter flowed, Dust of Suleiman lay in wait, and Ilvara reappeared after dissolving into spores.
source_quote: She came apart into the fungal matter beneath her feet — flowed through it like water pouring into a crack, like smoke running back into the dark — and reappeared somewhere else on the cavern floor.

subject: Phantasmal Killer
fact: Phantasmal Killer was among the options spread out on the Underdark equivalent of a table as a potential 4th-level spell deployment.
source_quote: Glyph of Warding. Dust of Suleiman. Phantasmal Killer. Fireball.

subject: Fireball
fact: Fireball was among the options spread out on the Underdark equivalent of a table as a potential 4th-level spell deployment.
source_quote: Glyph of Warding. Dust of Suleiman. Phantasmal Killer. Fireball.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir filed Ilvara’s scream of self-anger as a true indicator of damage inflicted, noting it as a psychological turning point.
source_quote: *She's angry at herself,* I noted, and filed it away, and watched.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree offered Ilvara’s magical items as additional payment, with the caveat that they might be contaminated, and filed that caveat.
source_quote: She offered Ilvara's magical items as additional payment, with the caveat that they might be contaminated. I noted that caveat. I filed it.

subject: Negotiation Stance
fact: The reply 'I already feel the gratitude of Lolth. I have that.' was delivered without a beat's pause, with dryness that lent authenticity to the deluded-believer angle.
source_quote: I delivered it without a beat's pause. The dryness of it, I think, may have done more for the deluded-believer angle than anything else I'd attempted — it had the specific texture of a man who genuinely believes his spiritual compensation is already sufficient and is asking a practical follow-up question.

subject: Bridge Inspection
fact: Grygum inscribed the Glyph of Warding into the bridge stone; Thorin watched the whole process with the specific attention of someone who needs to not step in that spot when things start moving fast.
source_quote: I watched the whole process with the specific attention of someone who needs to *not step in that spot* when things start moving fast.

subject: Fungal Cloud Detonation
fact: The Big Heart Fungus detonated a twenty-foot spore-thick poison cloud that hung in the cavern air like it had decided to stay — confirming Grygum’s note: *not scenery*.
source_quote: The moment it detonated that cloud across the cavern floor, every instinct I had confirmed the notation. *not scenery*.

subject: Elevated Platform
fact: Zalthir arrived on the elevated platform, adjacent to Ilvara, inside the radius where a priestess stops being an authority and becomes a target.
source_quote: One moment I was reading the geometry of the space — the elevated platform, the sightlines, the gap between us and her — and the next I was already there, adjacent, inside the radius where a priestess stops being an authority and becomes a target.

subject: Mushroom Artifact from Neverlight Grove
fact: The mushroom artifact from Neverlight Grove was the mechanism of corruption, the trigger for the fungal transformation of Ilvara’s allies.
source_quote: The mushroom artifact from Neverlight Grove was the mechanism of corruption.

subject: Reassignment of Responsibility
fact: Asha Vandree had always intended to kill Ilvara — that was what the wizard was for — and had survived long enough to find useful lunatics willing to close the distance for her.
source_quote: I was going to kill her. That is what you… where you come in.

subject: Familiar Acceptance
fact: Asha Vandree assessed Glabbagool as a bound familiar — the grey-ooze creature, strange and drifting and thoroughly uncategorizable — and accepted him as fitting neatly into the profile of a deluded mage who nonetheless had genuine and unusual power.
source_quote: She assessed. She accepted Glabbagool as a bound familiar — the grey-ooze creature, strange and drifting and thoroughly uncategorizable, fitting quite neatly into the profile of a deluded mage who nonetheless had genuine and unusual power.

subject: Delusion as Tactical Asset
fact: Madness with followers is not simply pathetic — it is tactically interesting. It suggests either genuine power or a sufficiently compelling delusion, and from Asha's position, the practical difference between those two things was probably small.
source_quote: Madness with followers is not simply pathetic — it is tactically interesting. It suggests either genuine power or a sufficiently compelling delusion, and from Asha's position, the practical difference between those two things was probably small.

subject: Hate as Immunological Theory
fact: Jorlan remained uninfected through hatred, which is its own kind of immunological theory — a psychological barrier against corruption.
source_quote: Jorlan through hatred, which is its own kind of immunological theory.

subject: Sustained Distance Protocol
fact: Twenty feet of maintained distance and separate food were the only protocols observed to avoid fungal contamination.
source_quote: Twenty feet of maintained distance. Separate food.

subject: Spell Slot Allocation
fact: Grygum had one 4th-level slot. Daz had one 4th-level slot. Those are not renewable resources in the next twenty minutes, so every piece of this had to land somewhere it mattered.
source_quote: Grygum had one 4th-level slot. Daz had one 4th-level slot. Those are not renewable resources in the next twenty minutes, so every piece of this had to land somewhere it mattered.

subject: Silent Blood Oath
fact: Grygum and Thorin both looked at the mushroom artifact and said nothing — the equivalent of a blood oath between two who had been where that road goes.
source_quote: The artifact sitting there like a dare, and the warning coming down with actual gravity: *do not touch it*. Grygum and I had both been where that road goes. I didn't need the long version. Neither did he. We both just said nothing, which for us was the equivalent of a blood oath.

subject: Fungal Resilience
fact: The Big Heart Fungus would not die quickly or easily — it required sustained damage to neutralize.
source_quote: The Big Heart Fungus was the primary weapon, would need sustained damage, would not die quickly or easily.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by Grygum as the authority who decides the fate of failed Drow.
source_quote: Zalthir might decide his fate should be precisely like Serith's

subject: bridge
fact: The bridge contains a Glyph of Warding, placed with exactly this kind of chaos in mind.
source_quote: We'd placed it with exactly this kind of chaos in mind

subject: Dust of Suleiman
fact: The Dust of Suleiman is a resource committed directly onto the Big Heart Fungus.
source_quote: I committed the Dust of Suleiman and cast it directly onto the fungus

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is referenced by Daz as the authority who decides the fate of failed Drow.
source_quote: Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Serith's

subject: spore servant
fact: The spore servant is a former Velkynvelve guard repurposed by Zuggtmoy's influence.
source_quote: Former Velkynvelve guards. I recognized the posture of soldiers whose bodies had been repurposed, the fungal colonization of Zuggtmoy's influence made visible

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is referenced by Grygum as the one who committed to the trap on the bridge.
source_quote: Jorlan didn't hesitate, didn't slow — he came across that bridge like a man who had already decided the outcome

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is referenced by Daz as the one who pressed the Sap after the Glyph detonated.
source_quote: I was already closing on Jorlan. ... I pressed the Sap after it

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is referenced by Grygum as the one who cast the Fireball that overlapped with the Dust of Suleiman.
source_quote: Then Daz's shaped Fireball hit — Ilvara and the Zuggtmoy icon both, simultaneously

subject: Glyph of Warding
fact: The Glyph of Warding was placed on the bridge by Grygum's idea and the group's execution.
source_quote: The Glyph was Grygum's idea, or at least Grygum's mouth. The placement was all of us.

subject: cavern floor
fact: The cavern floor is the origin of the spore servants, repurposed by Zuggtmoy's influence.
source_quote: Rising from the cavern floor with the patient, purposeless movement of things that are no longer choosing to move — they are simply directed.

subject: Fireball
fact: The Fireball was cast at fourth level with eight dice, sculpted to avoid Zalthir and Thorin.
source_quote: Fireball. Cast at fourth level. Eight dice. ... I carve them out. The fire will know the shape of them by the time it arrives and it will go around

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum called out, 'Come get it, idiot,' and detonated the Glyph of Warding.
source_quote: Grygum called out. 'Come get it, idiot.'

subject: Asha
fact: Asha is referenced by Daz as the source of the stakes that prevent him from filing away the mission's importance.
source_quote: Asha was explicit enough about what's riding on this that I haven't been able to fully file it away

subject: Big Heart Fungus
fact: The Big Heart Fungus is still standing, anchoring the far end of the battlefield, and remains the reason Zalthir is hovering.
source_quote: The Big Heart Fungus. Still standing. Still anchoring the far end of the battlefield. Still the reason Zalthir was hovering above the fight instead of in it.

subject: Valen
fact: Valen is referenced by Grygum as someone who could have been one of the repurposed guards.
source_quote: Valen, who had been one of them. Who could have been one of them, differently categorized.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is the blade Thorin used to deliver a critical hit to Jorlan after the Glyph detonated.
source_quote: Dawnbringer came down — crit, the blade's light cutting into him hard and clean, 14 damage landing exactly where it needed to.

subject: spore line
fact: The spore line is the boundary above which Zalthir hovers, separating him from the worst of the cloud.
source_quote: hovering in that particular way of someone who has made the tactically correct decision and is not happy about it. ... from somewhere above the spore line

subject: Zuggtmoy
fact: Zuggtmoy is referenced as the source of the fungal colonization that repurposed the Velkynvelve guards.
source_quote: the fungal colonization of Zuggtmoy's influence made visible

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan is referenced by Daz as the environment where Ilvara survived through social cunning.
source_quote: she did not survive this long in Menzoberranzan's social ecosystem by being slow

subject: Sap
fact: The Sap is a maneuver Thorin used to shove Jorlan off-balance after the Glyph detonated.
source_quote: I pressed the Sap after it, using the momentum wrong to do something right — shoving him off-balance, leaving him on the back foot

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is referenced by Grygum as the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: I am the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard

subject: Bahamut
fact: Bahamut is referenced as possibly watching, though notes are taken either way.
source_quote: Bahamut may or may not have been watching. I took notes either way.

subject: bridge
fact: The bridge is the site where the Glyph of Warding detonated, causing force and light to erupt in a sphere.
source_quote: The Glyph fired. Force and light erupted outward in a sphere, the kind of detonation that doesn't care who's in the way.

subject: Dust of Suleiman
fact: The Dust of Suleiman is a non-replaceable resource committed to the Big Heart Fungus.
source_quote: This was not a small resource. I made the decision anyway

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, 'Kaboom,' and then, 'I didn't expect it to work,' with genuine surprise.
source_quote: Grygum said, 'Kaboom!' And then, with something like genuine surprise underneath it: 'I didn't expect it to work.'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said nothing about Zalthir and Thorin being unsinged, though he noted it.
source_quote: I note that Zalthir is unsinged. I note that Thorin is unsinged. I don't say anything about it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, 'That worked better than I had any right to expect,' after Daz's Fireball.
source_quote: Grygum's voice cuts through the settling heat: 'That worked better than I had any right to expect.'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz calculated the placement of Fireball to overlap Ilvara and the icon, using Sculpt Spells to avoid allies.
source_quote: Both targets, one sphere, and the geometry cooperates if I'm exact. ... I carve them out.

subject: cavern
fact: The cavern went briefly and magnificently wrong in all the right ways after the overlapping spells.
source_quote: The cavern went briefly and magnificently wrong in all the right ways.

subject: Fireball
fact: The Fireball was cast at fourth level and dealt twelve damage to both Ilvara and the icon.
source_quote: Ilvara takes twelve. The icon takes twelve.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted the conditions that made the Glyph work: bait the ego, trust the glyph, commit the resource, let Daz do what Daz does.
source_quote: I noted the specific combination of factors that had produced that outcome: bait the ego, trust the glyph, commit the resource, let Daz do what Daz does.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noted the legendary action of the servant that landed a glancing blow for 5 damage.
source_quote: One of the servants wasn't finished with me. Legendary action, a swing that went so wide it almost circled back around to being impressive — natural 1, nothing — and then the follow-up connected for 5. Glancing. A reminder. Fair enough. I noted it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the Fireball's success was not remarkable because it was the plan.
source_quote: Plans working is not remarkable. But I notice.

subject: bridge
fact: The bridge is the site where Jorlan ran toward the Glyph, convinced he was reaching his prize.
source_quote: he came across that bridge like a man who had already decided the outcome. ... when you're already running at what you think is your prize.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum called Jorlan an idiot and invited him toward the Glyph, betting on ego overriding tactical awareness.
source_quote: You call a man an idiot and invite him toward an explosive ward and you are making a bet on ego overriding tactical awareness

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is referenced as having found purpose in precision and force, rejecting the notion that precision is the opposite of force.
source_quote: Precision is not the opposite of force. It is force, directed.

subject: cavern
fact: The cavern was ten minutes ago merely dangerous, but became a space filled with fire, spore, and disruption.
source_quote: a space that had, ten minutes ago, been merely dangerous — 'than I had any right to expect.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir said, 'Those poor guards. They've been through quite a lot,' from his aerial vantage point.
source_quote: Zalthir said, from his aerial vantage point, 'Those poor guards. They've been through quite a lot.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, 'I didn't expect it to work,' after the Glyph detonated, with honesty.
source_quote: 'I didn't expect it to work.' That last part was honest.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the Fireball's outcome changed the math of the fight in their favor.
source_quote: Twelve points is twelve points and the board looks different than it did thirty seconds ago, and that is the only metric that has ever mattered.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noted the conditions under which the Sap succeeded: using momentum wrong to do something right.
source_quote: using the momentum wrong to do something right — shoving him off-balance

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that Jorlan's certainty was almost giant-brained, and that giants are usually right about the terrain.
source_quote: There's something almost giant-brained about that kind of certainty. Giants move like that. ... The problem is, giants are usually right about the terrain.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Ilvara survived long in Menzoberranzan's social ecosystem by not being slow.
source_quote: she did not survive this long in Menzoberranzan's social ecosystem by being slow

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the Glyph worked because they stopped expecting it to work.
source_quote: you stop expecting it, almost. You get tactical, you do the work, you lay the trap in exactly the right place — and then somewhere between placing it and watching it detonate, you forget to believe in yourself.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the battlefield fragmented faster than any of them had planned for.
source_quote: The battlefield had fragmented faster than any of us had planned for, allies pulled in three different directions by pressure we hadn't fully mapped before we walked in.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the stakes were not abstract — they were Asha and everything she told him.
source_quote: The stakes are not abstract. The stakes are Asha, and everything she told me

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the difference between soldiers and weapons is sometimes just time and circumstance.
source_quote: Soldiers. Now weapons. The difference between the two is sometimes just time and circumstance

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the Fireball's success was not remarkable because it was the plan.
source_quote: Plans working is not remarkable. But I notice.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the Dust of Suleiman was not a small resource, and he made the decision anyway.
source_quote: This was not a small resource. I made the decision anyway

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the Fireball's geometry cooperated because he was exact.
source_quote: the geometry cooperates if I'm exact

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the Glyph's detonation caused twenty-one damage to the cluster.
source_quote: Twenty-one damage blooming through the cluster all at once

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the spore servant that came apart completely was just gone.
source_quote: One servant came apart completely. Just gone.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that Jorlan took the full force of the Glyph and now the Dawnbringer strike.
source_quote: He'd taken the full force of the Glyph and now this.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Ilvara half-saved the Fireball, which was professionally irritating but not unexpected.
source_quote: She half-saves, which is professionally irritating but not unexpected

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the fight was far from over, even after the spells.
source_quote: The fungus was still standing. The fight was far from over.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the icon and Ilvara were still standing after the Fireball.
source_quote: The icon is still standing. Ilvara is still standing.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the spore servants staggered in a way that suggested they had not enjoyed the experience.
source_quote: The others staggered in a way that suggested they had not enjoyed the experience.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that Jorlan was not having his best moment after the Glyph detonated.
source_quote: Jorlan himself was not having his best moment.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the battlefield had shifted in their favor after the combined spells.
source_quote: The battlefield had shifted in our favor

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the Fireball's placement was the most useful thing he knows how to do.
source_quote: It is perhaps the most useful thing I know how to do.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the Glyph was placed like a welcome mat.
source_quote: We'd laid it on the bridge like a welcome mat

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the difference between soldiers and weapons is sometimes just time and circumstance, and he filed that thought away under 'things not to dwell on mid-combat.'
source_quote: I filed that thought away under *things not to dwell on mid-combat*.

fact: Daz noted that the Fireball's success was not remarkable because it was the plan, and he noticed anyway.
source_quote: Plans working is not remarkable. But I notice.

fact: Grygum noted that the Glyph's detonation caused a sphere of force and light that didn't care who was in the way.
source_quote: Force and light erupted outward in a sphere, the kind of detonation that doesn't care who's in the way.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that the spore servant that barely held together was listing like a wall with one stone pulled from its base.
source_quote: I watched one barely hold together, listing like a wall with one stone pulled from its base.

fact: Daz noted that the Fireball's damage to Ilvara and the icon was twelve each.
source_quote: Ilvara takes twelve. The icon takes twelve.

fact: Grygum noted that the Glyph was placed by the group's execution, not just Grygum's idea.

fact: Grygum noted that Jorlan came across the bridge like a man who had already decided the outcome.

fact: Daz noted that the Fireball's success was a bet on precision overriding the need for coverage.
source_quote: But coverage is not what I need. I need placement.

fact: Grygum noted that the Dust of Suleiman was committed because the creature had already demonstrated what it was willing to do.
